text: inside of the mesh painting tools, can you add painting layers, so that i stop having to be so exact when trying to do basically anything lol its kinda a pain in the ass when its all one layer
resolution: Mesh-painter improvements (Studio paint mode). DONE: (1) painting LAYERS — independent surfaces composited into the texture the mesh samples, with add/hide/reorder/duplicate/delete/rename/opacity and erase-through (new GPU composite + dest-out host ops in paintable.zig; layers are session-scoped, flattened to the durable paintRef so compile/load-from-prop are unchanged); (2) recents no longer flooded by the colour-wheel drag (ColorField onCommit vs onChange; record a recent only on a settled colour); (3) durable + cross-asset saved palettes in localstore (new paintPalettes.ts + a PALETTES panel); (4) rubber-band ghost preview for line/rect/ellipse. Everything builds: rjit ship hmsc-int fast-path exit 0, cart bundles clean. NOT fixed: the 'numbers wipe when placed in the map' report — digits 0-9 exist in both glyph fonts, layoutText emits digit cells, and the bake/compile path carries the texture wholesale with no digit-specific code, so I could not reproduce it statically and did not guess; needs a concrete repro. Painted output can't be self-shot headless (paintable capture limit), so live verification in rjit dev is needed.
